The 3-star smoke-free hotel features 98 rooms and such amenities as a restaurant and a storage for belongings. This Hanoi hotel has a prime setting 3.4 km from the Temple of Literature, while natural sights like the fresh water Hoan Kiem Lake are 2.3 km away. Guests can easily reach the Hai Ba Trung Temple which is within a few blocks of the comfortable A25 Hotel - 185-187 Lo Duc Hanoi. The accommodation is also nestled near parks. Standing about a 30-minute walk away, the majestic church "Saint Joseph Cathedral" is a hard-to-miss divine tourist destination. 340-342 Tran Khat Chan bus stop, offering a direct link to the city attractions and main places, is 300 m from the A25 Hotel - 185-187 Lo Duc Hanoi. Featuring a mini-fridge-bar and an electric kettle, the rooms are air-conditioned and equipped with complimentary Wi-Fi and cable channels. The air-conditioned rooms have private bathrooms fitted with a separate toilet and a shower. Nice touches to enhance your stay include a separate toilet and a shower, along with hairdryers and bath sheets. The hotel serves a complimentary buffet breakfast. The fast food restaurant Rand Moroc and Coffee is located a short way from A25 Hotel - 185-187 Lo Duc.
